description: This file contains partial class definitions and extensions related to Azure Storage-based grain directory implementation in Orleans, including options, validators, and directory management classes.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectoryOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Table Grain Directory, including default table name.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptions
classes.description: Base class for Azure Storage operation options, including client configuration.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptionsValidator`1
classes.description: Generic validator for Azure Storage operation options.

classes.name: AzureStoragePolicyOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring Azure Storage policies such as retries and timeouts.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implementation of grain directory using Azure Table Storage, supporting lookup, register, unregister, and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: ConfigureTableServiceClient
methods.description: Obsolete method to configure TableServiceClient with various parameters.

methods.name: InitializeIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes the directory if not already initialized.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a grain address by grain ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address, optionally with a previous address.
